# Completion of an in-flight request along its retained route

<a id="主张-claim"></a>
## Claim

For every partial law that, while a task is pending, does one unit of its remaining work per tick and finishes when none is left, the task finishes in exactly its remaining work plus one tick, and every shorter run leaves it pending with the work lowered by the ticks taken; with fuel counted, work + 1 ticks finish exactly when the fuel covers them. The versioned queue's head is such a task: under the bank/queue invariant each tick does one hop of its remaining path, so the head completes after its remaining path length plus one consecutive tick, emits its requested value and leaves the remaining queue, banks and active route unchanged, and no shorter drain delivers it.

Canonical source: [CorrectionVersioned.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/universal-ethics/generative-capacity/CorrectionVersioned.lean)
